kind: Verified training settings and source provenance, not fitted parameters or performance results.

random_forest.evidence: Read-only nonexecuting pickle opcode inspection before any tree arrays, first 64 KiB only. The associated paper prediction file has no global model metadata, so the artifact-to-prediction link remains based on the provenance audit.
random_forest.feature_interpretation: 31 is consistent with eight variables, y/x, lat/lon, landmask, month/day-of-year, eight daily normals, and eight anomalies; exact historical flags and climatology sampling were not embedded in the artifact.
random_forest.new_workflow: Training now embeds feature schema, normalization/grid fingerprint and fitted training climatology in the estimator. Generation restores this state. Legacy recomputation requires an explicit opt-in and does not represent a training-only workflow.

historical_loader: Archived packed AORC scaling/time/missing-value semantics require explicit aorc_legacy configuration, which rejects physical stores and stats. New defaults use shared physical_pair and never apply packed-number scales.
evaluation_samples: Original classical baseline outputs contain early-2012 samples; do not assert they match the all-year deep-learning evaluation without explicit reference/time checks.
